# appgatesdp_auto_update_settings (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `criteria_script` (String) The Criteria Script to evaluate the Client claims during authorization in order to decide whether the Client Auto-Update will be applied or not.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Client Auto-Update is enabled or not.
- `fedora` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fedora))
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `mac_os` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mac_os))
- `red_hat` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--red_hat))
- `red_hat8` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--red_hat8))
- `ubuntu` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ubuntu))
- `windows` (Attributes) Client Auto-Update settings for the specified platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows))

<a id="nestedatt--fedora"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fedora`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) A publicly acceessible URL for Clients to download the installer from.
- `version` (String) The version string to compare the Client version. If the Client version is lower than the setting (and the Criteria Script returns true), Client will receive the update notification with the URL setting.
